items.headline: Amari Odom's 6 TDs and 2-point conversion help Syracuse survive UConn 42-41 in overtime
items.description: — Just two days after Amari Odom was told he would be the starting quarterback in Syracuse's road game against UConn, the ball was in his hands with the Orange looking to leave Rentschler Field on a winning note.

items.headline: David McComb leads Miami (Ohio) to 24-21 victory over UConn
items.description: — David McComb threw for 312 yards and two touchdowns and added a rushing score as Miami (Ohio) rallied from a 14-point deficit to beat Connecticut 24-21 on Saturday.
